messages:
Tina Chen: hey folks — where's the prod KV prefix cache hit-rate dashboard? Pager woke me at 03:15 for a noisy alert and I can't find the panel in console.

Kai Patel: dash link is https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/d-9a2k/kv-prefix-hit-rate — add ?env=prod to get prod view.

Marta López: also the panel lives under Serving > Cache in the eng-platform folder, but the direct link Kai gave is the fastest.

infra-bot: ALERT: KVPREFIX_CACHE_HITRATE_LOW fired for service=serving-prod (threshold: < 70% over 10m). Incident #INC-3328.

Tina Chen: thanks — the alert seems tuned to 70% but our baseline dropped to ~65% after yesterday's rollout. It looked like a noisy (non-impacting) page. Can we avoid paging on known baseline shifts?

Kai Patel: can you paste the prometheus query you used? want to verify baseline numbers before changing thresholds.

Tina Chen: ran this in grafana explore:
```
100 * sum(rate(kv_prefix_cache_hits_total{env=\"prod\"}[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_prefix_cache_requests_total{env=\"prod\"}[5m]))
```
Returns ~64-66% over last 24h.

Marta López: note: we rolled a quantized model yesterday which changes request patterns for long prefixes — expected hit-rate dip. Proposal: set alert to warn at 60% (slack), page at 50%. Or increase evaluation window to 30m to avoid transient pages.

Kai Patel: +1 on increasing window. Also would be good to add a small panel for prefix size distribution + prefetch miss rate so oncall can quickly see cause. I'll open a PR for alert tweak + extra panels.

Tina Chen: SGTM. Please tag me on the PR and add a short changelog entry. cc @growth-sre :eyes:

Alex R: oncall here — if we change paging thresholds, do it behind alert-group ops. I can update the alert to warning@slack at 60 and page at 50 after PR merges.

Kai Patel: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1287 — \"observability: adjust kv prefix cache alert and add prefix-size panel\". Includes query window change to 30m and new dashboard bookmark. PTAL.

Tina Chen: reviewed, left one nit about the query label. if we switch to 30m please mention in the ops changelog so SRE knows expected reduced paging. :thumbsup:

Marta López: added a console bookmark -> https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/d-9a2k/kv-prefix-hit-rate?env=prod&bookmark=prefetch (folder: eng-platform/observability).

Kai Patel: thanks — merging after one more ack. Will coordinate with Alex for alert rollout. Closing loop here, will follow up in the PR for any fixes.

growth-sre: noted. will monitor related paging after change and report any regressions. :raised_hands:
